description: Which new rules on my topic are coming in Japan or the US, and when can I still comment?. One finished brief per topic: Japanese e-Gov public-comment drafts still open, US Federal Register proposed rules with open comment windows, US final rules and Japanese law amendments published but not yet in force, and recent Japanese comment results with the number of comments received. Plain English or Japanese keywords (drone, AI, food labeling, tax, 建築, 医薬品). Deadlines, days left, counts and topic matching computed by Lilambd from official registers; every item links to its official page. Japanese titles stay in Japanese; US items carry title_en. Facts only, not legal advice. Routes: /answer (topic*, country, limit, routine); /topics (country, limit); /upcoming (country, status, topic, kind, stage, agency, category, since, until, sort, limit, offset). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /topics, /upcoming. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: rules-ahead
